{{Current events|year=2023|month=01|day=27|content=
<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Eastern Ukraine campaign]]
****[[Ukraine]] says that "fierce fighting" is underway in the east and northeast of the country as [[Russian Ground Forces|Russian troops]] try to break through Ukrainian defensive lines in [[Kharkiv Oblast|Kharkiv]], [[Donetsk Oblast|Donetsk]], [[Luhansk Oblast|Luhansk]] and [[Zaporizhzhia Oblast]]s. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-unleashes-missiles-drones-ukraine-after-kyiv-secures-tanks-11-dead-2023-01-26/ (Reuters)]
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**[[Gaza–Israel conflict]]
***[[Israeli Air Force]] jets launch [[airstrike]]s on an underground rocket manufacturing site, and a [[military base]] used by [[Hamas]] in the [[Gaza Strip]], in response to [[Palestinian rocket attacks on Israel|rockets fired by Palestinian militants]] into southern [[Israel]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/rocket-warning-sirens-set-off-southern-israel-israeli-army-2023-01-26/ (Reuters)]
**[[2023 East Jerusalem synagogue shooting]]
***Seven [[Israeli Jews]] are killed and three others are injured in a shooting at a [[synagogue]] in [[Jerusalem]]. The perpetrator is killed by police. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-64430491 (BBC News)]
*[[Azerbaijan–Iran relations]], [[Terrorism in Iran]]
**[[Attack on the Azerbaijani embassy in Tehran]]
***A guard is killed and two others are injured during a shooting at the [[Azerbaijan]]i [[embassy]] in [[Tehran]], [[Iran]]. The perpetrator is arrested. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/1/27/armed-attack-azerbaijan-embassy-iran-kills (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**[[Use of chemical weapons in the Syrian civil war]]
***The [[Organisation for the Prohibition of Chemical Weapons]] concludes with "reasonable grounds" that the [[Douma chemical attack]] that occurred in 2018, was carried out by the [[Syrian Armed Forces|Syrian military]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/1/27/opcw-blames-syria-government-forces-for-2018-douma-chlorine-gas-attack (Al Jazeera)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 North Island floods]]
**Three people are killed and another person is missing during severe [[flash flood]]ing in [[New Zealand]]'s largest city [[Auckland]]. [https://i.stuff.co.nz/national/weather-news/300794223/live-auckland-faces-more-rain-after-wettest-day-on-record-3-dead-states-of-emergency-in-effect-for-supercity-and-waitomo (Stuff)]
*[[Environmental issues in Pakistan]]
**At least 18 people have been killed in the past two weeks by toxic chemicals from factories in [[Karachi]], [[Sindh]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/1/27/toxic-chemicals-allegedly-kill-18-people-in-pakistans-karachi (Al Jazeera)]
*A [[Russia]]n [[Mi-8]] helicopter of the {{ill|"Rossiya" special flight squad|ru|Специальный лётный отряд «Россия»}}, which transports members of the [[Government of Russia|government]] and [[Russian Armed Forces|armed forces]], [[aviation accidents and incidents|crashes]] at the [[Vnukovo Airport]] in [[Moscow]]. According to some reports there are injuries, with [[TASS]] reporting that [[pilot error]] is the main cause of the helicopter crash. [https://rtvi.com/news/vo-vnukovo-razbilsya-vertolet-mi-8/ (RTVI)]
*Five people are killed as a result of [[landslide]]s and floods in [[Manado]], [[North Sulawesi]], [[Indonesia]]. [https://www.cnnindonesia.com/nasional/20230128085908-20-905922/lima-orang-tewas-akibat-banjir-dan-tanah-longsor-di-kota-manado/ (CNN Indonesia)]
*Two people are killed and seven others are injured after a suspected [[gas explosion]] destroys half a house in [[Katowice]], [[Silesian Voivodeship]], [[Poland]]. [https://apnews.com/article/poland-katowice-religion-children-missing-persons-369e0e251940a01393ae384929b28528 (AP)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[Rewilding (conservation biology)|Rewilding]]
**[[Cheetah reintroduction in India]]
***[[South Africa]] agrees to send twelve [[cheetah]]s to [[India]] each year for the next eight to ten years to help secure a viable wild population. The [[Asiatic cheetah]] went [[extinction|extinct]] in India in the [[1940s]] due to [[overhunting]] and [[habitat destruction]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-64425297 (BBC News)]
*[[Western Australian radioactive capsule incident]]
**A [[radioactive]] capsule is missing along a 1,400-kilometre stretch of highway in [[Western Australia]]. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2023-01-27/radioactive-capsule-lost-in-wa-emergency-public-health-warning/101901472 (ABC News Australia)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Killing of Tyre Nichols]]
**[[Tyre Nichols protests]]
***Authorities in [[Memphis, Tennessee]], [[United States]], release footage of 29-year-old Tyre Nichols being violently assaulted by multiple [[Memphis Police Department]] officers during a [[traffic stop]] on January 7. [https://apnews.com/article/tyre-nichols-video-memphis-police-e3ee8e6698faae16df3f41d09234b09f (AP)]
*[[Cannabis in Hong Kong]]
**[[Hong Kong]]'s [[Customs and Excise Department (Hong Kong)|Customs and Excise Department]] announces that all products containing [[cannabidiol]] will be banned as of February 1 and that the chemical will be classified in the same category as [[heroin]] and [[cocaine]]. [https://www.scmp.com/news/hong-kong/law-and-crime/article/3208214/hong-kongs-ban-products-contain-cbd-comes-effect-next-week-customs-warns (''South China Morning Post'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2023 Czech presidential election]]
**[[Czechs]] head to [[polling place|the polls]] to vote in the second round of the [[presidential election]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-64421310 (BBC News)]
*[[Greek wiretapping scandal of 2022]]
**[[Prime Minister of Greece|Prime Minister]] [[Kyriakos Mitsotakis]] survives a [[Motion of no confidence|no-confidence vote]] called by former [[prime minister]] [[Alexis Tsipras]] over a [[wiretapping]] scandal. [https://www.thesundaily.my/world/greek-government-survives-no-confidence-vote-LB10559471 (AFP via ''The Sun'')]
<!-- All news items above this line -->}}
